# Unit test for function solve
def test_solve():
    # Test case: lowercase letters become uppercase
    assert solve("1234567") == "7654321"  # no alpha -> reversed
    assert solve("ab") == "AB"            # swapcase
    assert solve("#a@C") == "#A@c"        # mixed swapcase
    assert solve("#AsdW@") == "#aSDw@"    # mixed swapcase
    
    # Test case: uppercase letters become lowercase
    assert solve("ABC") == "abc"
    
    # Test case: mixed alpha and non-alpha
    assert solve("a1b2") == "A1B2"
    assert solve("!@#") == "#@!"          # no alpha -> reversed
    assert solve("1234") == "4321"        # no alpha -> reversed
    
    # Test case: empty string
    assert solve("") == ""
    
    # Test case: single character
    assert solve("a") == "A"
    assert solve("Z") == "z"
    assert solve("5") == "5"              # single non-alpha, reversed is same
    
    # Test case: spaces and special characters
    assert solve("Hello World!") == "hELLO wORLD!"
    assert solve("   ") == "   "          # only spaces -> reversed (same)
    
    # Test case: already swapped case
    assert solve("AbCdEf") == "aBcDeF"
    
    # Test case: digits only, odd length
    assert solve("987") == "789"
    
    print("All tests passed!")


# Run tests
if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_solve()
